name: Game AI agent benchmarking research loop

mentions.name: Game AI agent benchmarking research loop
mentions.description: This project benchmarks AI agents in a research loop, using models to understand and explore builds and gameplay through reasoning-based game AI rather than traditional reinforcement learning. It also includes interactive ways to view the experiment and visualize the results.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been playing with benchmarking agents in a research loop. The experiment leans on using these models to understand and explore builds/gameplay through reasoning game AI over traditional reinforcement learning.

Also, creating interactive ways to view the experiment and visualizating the results.
